# ASSIGNMENT 1

##QN 1;  Loading data sets

-Malaria cases, suspected, number.csv

-MALARIA_TOTAL_CASES.dta

-ITN Access.xlsx (Read both sheets)

```{r}
#loading( Malaria cases, suspected, number.csv using read.csv)
malaria_cases_df <- read.csv(here::here("data", "raw", "Malaria cases, suspected, number.csv"))
```

loading MALARIA_TOTAL_CASES.dta 

```{r}
#loading MALARIA_TOTAL_CASES.dta using haven package
#haven package installed in console
library(haven)
malaria_total_cases_df <- read_dta(here::here("data", "raw", "MALARIA_TOTAL_CASES.dta"))

```

Loading ITN Access; both sheets
```{r}
#Loading ITN Access using the readxl package
#readxl package installed in console

library(readxl)
itn_access1 <- read_excel(here::here("data", "raw", "ITN Access.xlsx"), sheet = 1)   # read sheet 1

itn_access2 <- read_excel(here::here("data", "raw", "ITN Access.xlsx"), sheet = 2)  #read sheet 2

```

## QN 2; EXPLORING THE DATASETS


```{r}
View(malaria_cases_df)  #view malaria_cases_df

head(malaria_total_cases_df, 10) #obtain first 10 rows of dataframe

tail(itn_access1, 9) # obtain last 9 rows of dataframe

```

## QN 3; View the first 10 columns for the first 30 countries in the MALARIA_TOTAL_CASES.dta dataset
```{r}
#using indexing
malaria_total_cases_df[1:30,1:10]
```

## QN 4; From the "ITN access" sheet of ITN Access.xlsx, display all rows for the following columns: Indicator, ParentLocation, SpatialDimValueCode, Period, and FactValueNumeric


```{r}
#using indexing
itn_access1[1:360, c("Indicator", "ParentLocation", "SpatialDimValueCode", "Period", "FactValueNumeric")]


#using dplyr
library(dplyr)
itn_access1  %>% select("Indicator", "ParentLocation", "SpatialDimValueCode", "Period", "FactValueNumeric")%>% View()
```

## QN 5; Using the str() function, determine the data type for each of the following columns: Indicator, ParentLocation, SpatialDimValueCode, Period, and FactValueNumeric in the "ITN access" sheet of ITN Access.xlsx.

```{r}
#using indexing
str(itn_access1[c("Indicator", "ParentLocation", "SpatialDimValueCode", "Period", "FactValueNumeric")])
```


```{r}
#using dplyr
library(dplyr)
str(select(itn_access1, "Indicator", "ParentLocation", "SpatialDimValueCode", "Period", "FactValueNumeric"))
```
After using the above methods; the structure of the datasets is as follows; 
-Indicator is character
-ParentLocation is character
-SpatialDimValueCode is character
-Period is numeric
-FactValueNumeric is numeric


## QN 6; Using the summary() function, determine the mean, minimum, and maximum number of malaria cases from the Malaria cases, suspected, number.csv dataset.
```{r}

summary(malaria_cases_df) #summarises the Malaria cases, suspected, number.csv dataset.

summary(malaria_cases_df$FactValueNumeric) #focuses on the FactValueNumeric column

#MALARIA CASES
#mean was 4877290
#minimum was  121
#maximum was 164949610
```


  
# ASSIGNMENT 2
Merge/ bring in the "location" column from itn_access2 to itn_access1

```{r}
#using dplyr
itn_merged <- left_join(itn_access1, itn_access2, by="SpatialDimValueCode")

str(itn_merged) # using the str() function; you can see the the location column has been added
```
